newsitem.title: USA: Guaranty Financial to trade on Nasdaq NMS.
newsitem.headline: Guaranty Financial to trade on Nasdaq NMS.

text.p: Guaranty Financial Corp said Thursday its common stock will begin trading on the Nasdaq National Market on June 6.
The stock currently trades on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market and will continue to trade under the symbol "GSLC."

Guaranty also said the Federal Reserve has has included Guaranty's stock on the list of Marginable OTC Stocks which will allow brokers and dealers to make margin loans using the security as collateral and further improve the liquidity of the stock.
Guaranty is a unitary bank holding company which operates four offices in Charlottesville, Virginia and one office in Harrisonburg, Virginia.
